comment: P4.1b help-doc-sync differential spec (extended by P4.d6 for the 551f090b prune). The seed rows bake the pre-sync help_docs state: row 1 (getting-started) carries a STALE contentHash + an embedding, so the sync updates it and clears the embedding; row 2 (no-frontmatter) carries the MATCHING contentHash (sha256 of the trimmed fixture file bytes) plus a deliberately-different title, so the sync must leave the whole row (title, embedding, timestamps) untouched; row 3 (retired) has NO FILE on disk, so the P4.d6 prune must delete it and cascade to its embedding_status rows. The embeddingStatus seed proves the cascade is scoped and is a deleteMany: TWO rows for the retired doc (one per profile — both must go) and one for the SURVIVING getting-started doc (must remain). The fixture help tree lives at fixtures/help-sync/help/ (a .gitattributes pins *.md -text so crlf.md keeps its CRLF bytes).
